_comment: The cross-language contract fixture (§35 C4c, plan-conf-duplication.md D3): wire-riding values that Go and the client both restate by hand. Each side asserts its own table against this file — Go: backend/cmd/aurad/shared_constants_test.go, client: frontend/src/client-data/SharedConstants.test.ts — so a drift goes red on whichever side moved. Contract only (names ↔ values); colors, styles and pixel scaling stay client-side. Not loaded by the game: tests read it from the repo, so it needs no cp-defs/embed entry.
_skillPointCostComment: The D10 escalating point curve (plan-numbers-rewrite): buying a level costs `tier1Points` while the level is within the first `tier2AboveFraction` of the skill's OWN cap, `tier2Points` up to `tier3AboveFraction`, `tier3Points` beyond — thresholds rounded UP. Level 1 is free on unlock, so the first purchased level is 2. Cross-language because the client shows the cost on the spellbook + button. ⚑ Every value is [PLACEHOLDER], the fractions included.
